messages:
Marta Chen: Quick sync  Inference Launch Lab webinar next Thu 9am PT. Need reg page, Zoom ops, recording plan, and post-event lead flow. Who takes what?
Diego Alvarez: I can build the reg page. Single-field email + optional company, hidden utm fields, GDPR checkbox, and a small CTA to request clips. Need hero image and 50-char blurb.
Priya Singh: Dropping final copy in 20m. Will include privacy hovertext and a transcript opt-in.
Sam Cho: Zoom ops: cloud recording (active speaker + shared screen), separate audio tracks, enable SRT export, add two alternative hosts. Will enable auto-assign co-host to avoid host delay.
Noah Bennett: Ill own captions & transcript QA. Otter integration ok. Will upload SRT + plain transcript to Drive and tag clip owners (marketing-clip-ops). Aim +6h artifact delivery.
Tom Ruiz: HubSpot routing: form submit -> create contact, set original_source={{utm_source}}, add to list "LaunchLab-Regs", send immediate confirmation. Post-event: attended -> tag "attended" + send replay @24h; no-shows -> 48h nurture with 3 highlight clips.
Diego Alvarez: Question: two-step email verify? For dev audience, single-step to reduce friction.
Marta Chen: Agreed single-step. Add .ics to confirmation page and email.
Sam Cho: Contingency: local host recording and RTMP fallback if cloud fails. Ill bring spare laptop and run local recording during runthrough.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Inference Launch Lab"  Thu 9:00am PT  Zoom link added.
Marta Chen: Action recap: Diego=reg page+test, Priya=copy+confirm email, Sam=Zoom config+run, Noah=captions+handoff, Tom=HubSpot workflow. Stand-up tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
